I took the plate to be roughly a 24 cm square-ish dinner plate. These are rough estimates from the footprint and height of each item.

- **Bacon:** about 2–3 thin strips, each around 12 cm long. Cooked bacon is crispy and thin, so I estimated about 10 g.
- **Blueberries:** about 25 berries at roughly 1.5 g each, so about 35 g.
- **Strawberries:** one half, one slice and one small whole berry, about 25 g in total.
